intents.label: Greeting
intents.answer: Hi! I can help you find info about ICUE’s services, projects, recruitment, policies, and contact details. What are you looking for?

intents.label: Services
intents.answer: ICUE provides consulting related to planning/design, project management, procedure support, and sustainability-focused solutions. For project-specific guidance, send the project type, location, and required scope through the Contact page.

intents.label: Planning and design
intents.answer: ICUE can support planning and design depending on the project needs. A useful enquiry includes the site/location, goals, and current stage (idea / concept / detailed design) so the team can confirm an appropriate workflow.

intents.label: Project management
intents.answer: ICUE can provide project management and coordination support depending on scope. Include the timeline, stakeholders, and expected deliverables in your enquiry so the team can assess the work.

intents.label: Site supervision
intents.answer: Supervision/monitoring support depends on the project type, location, and phase (design / tender / construction). Send those details through the Contact page so ICUE can confirm what support is feasible.

intents.label: Permits and procedures
intents.answer: ICUE may assist with procedures and document preparation depending on the project and jurisdiction. Contact the team with the city/province and project type to confirm scope and likely document requirements.

intents.label: Required documents
intents.answer: Common starting documents include basic site information, goals/scope, existing drawings (if any), and relevant land-use or legal papers. Final requirements depend on the project and should be confirmed with ICUE.

intents.label: Service pricing
phrases: can i get a cost estimate
intents.answer: Fees vary by scope, timeline, and project complexity. Send a short brief through the Contact page—project type, location, size, timeline, and required output—for a project-specific estimate.

intents.label: Payment terms
intents.answer: Payment terms may be aligned with agreed milestones (for example, concept → draft → final). The applicable schedule must be confirmed in the written proposal or contract.

intents.label: Project process
intents.answer: A typical flow is: initial discussion → requirements → site/context review → draft deliverables → agreed revisions → final delivery. Exact stages and revision limits are confirmed for each project.

intents.label: Project timeline
intents.answer: The timeline depends on scope, approvals, and the required deliverables. Include your deadline and whether you need a concept or full package when contacting ICUE for an assessed schedule.

intents.label: BIM and 3D
intents.answer: ICUE can use BIM/3D modeling where appropriate to support visualization and design coordination. The available deliverables—such as models, views, or technical coordination—are confirmed in the project scope.

intents.label: Sustainability
intents.answer: ICUE can incorporate sustainability goals such as materials, energy use, and climate resilience depending on project context. Priorities and constraints should be included in the project brief.

intents.label: Clients and sectors
intents.answer: ICUE works with individuals, organizations/businesses, and public-sector stakeholders depending on the program or project. Published examples are available under Past Projects.

intents.label: Service locations
intents.answer: Service feasibility depends on the project location and whether remote or on-site support is required. Send the city/province and preferred working arrangement through the Contact page for confirmation.

intents.label: Past projects
intents.answer: You can browse published projects and activities under Work and Past Projects, including urban, environmental, and community work.

intents.label: News and updates
intents.answer: You can check the News page for recent updates and articles.

intents.label: Community activities
intents.answer: ICUE also runs/participates in community activities and programs. Check the Community Activities page for more.

intents.label: Recruitment
intents.answer: Check the Recruitment page for current roles and published requirements. Tailor your CV and application message to the listed responsibilities and include directly relevant experience.

intents.label: Internships
intents.answer: For internships, start with the Recruitment page. A concise application should highlight relevant study, practical skills, portfolio work, and what you hope to learn.

intents.label: Partnerships
intents.answer: ICUE is open to discussing collaboration where goals and scope align. A useful enquiry states who you are, the topic, your proposal, and the intended outcome.

intents.label: Media and press
intents.answer: For media or press requests, contact ICUE with the deadline, topic, publication, and requested contribution (quote / interview / speaker).

intents.label: Schedule a consultation
intents.answer: To request a consultation, use the Contact page and include your preferred time window, timezone, and the topic you want to discuss.

intents.label: Proposals and RFPs
intents.answer: Yes — if you share a brief scope (goals, deliverables, timeline, budget range if available), we can respond with a proposal structure and next steps.

intents.label: Policies
intents.answer: You can review ICUE’s Privacy, GDPR, Terms, and Cookies pages using the links below.

intents.label: FAQs
intents.answer: Use the FAQs page for quick answers. Questions asked here are matched only against ICUE’s authored intent and FAQ content.

fallback.answer: I’m not fully sure I understood. Could you clarify what you’re asking about (Services, Projects, Recruitment, Contact, or Policies)?
